title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram: interactive maps of GitHub repositories
friendlyTitle: GitDiagram draws a map of a GitHub project
summary: GitDiagram uses AI to turn a public or authorised private GitHub repository into an interactive architecture diagram. The MIT-licensed TypeScript project is actively maintained and has about 16,600 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: GitDiagram uses AI to make an interactive picture of how a code repository fits together. It has about 16,600 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to orient themselves in an unfamiliar codebase before reading individual files, or self-host it for internal repositories. Treat the diagram as a navigation aid rather than architectural truth, and use a narrowly scoped token for private code.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you understand an unfamiliar project more quickly. Check the real code before trusting the map, and limit access when using a private repository.
